explication: Faker is a pure Elixir library for generating fake data. A caller invokes its domain-specific functions and receives generated values; locale-specific modules provide datasets and generators across address, identity, food, travel, technology, and other topics. The shared Faker module exposes locale, sampling, and random helpers, with a configurable random backend. The README establishes the library’s purpose and startup usage; sampled source shows random delegation and selected domain behavior, but not dispatch wiring for the broader module set, so those links are omitted.
